content.content:
## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I switch plans anytime?
Yes! Upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately and we'll prorate any charges.

### Do you offer student discounts?
Absolutely. Students get 50% off Pro plans with valid .edu email verification.

### What's your refund policy?
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, we'll refund your payment in full.

### Is there a commitment?
No long-term contracts required. Cancel anytime with one click. Your access continues until the end of your billing period.

### Can I pay annually?
Yes! Annual plans save you 20% compared to monthly billing. Pay $279/year for Pro instead of $348.

meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Learn about LearnHub's mission to democratize education worldwide

content.headline: Education for Everyone, Everywhere
content.subhead: Our mission is to make high-quality education accessible to anyone with an internet connection.

content.content:
## Our Story

Founded in 2019, LearnHub was born from a simple observation: traditional education wasn't keeping pace with the modern world. Technology was advancing rapidly, but learning resources remained fragmented, expensive, and inaccessible to millions.

We set out to change that.

Starting with just 10 courses and a small team of passionate educators, we've grown into a global platform serving over 12,500 students across 150 countries. But our mission remains unchanged: **democratize access to world-class education**.

## Our Values

### Accessibility First
Education should never be a privilege. We keep our pricing affordable and offer generous scholarships to students in need.

### Quality Over Quantity
Every course is carefully vetted, designed by industry experts, and continuously updated to reflect current best practices.

### Community-Driven
Learning is social. We foster connections between students, encourage peer collaboration, and maintain active discussion forums.

### Lifelong Learning
Education doesn't stop at graduation. We support continuous skill development throughout your career journey.
